interpretation: Re-estimating both traits of each family-trait-pair cell on the identical shared-species set leaves cross-family trait-order reversal near 47% on both tree axes. Differences in species composition among traits therefore do not explain the near-half re-ordering.
hard_nonclaims: Species matching changes some individual family-pair orders and does not imply exact invariance of every rho estimate.
This analysis does not remove all measurement error or trait-state uncertainty.
